name: usage-radar
description: Live usage for Claude Code: your spend limit in dollars, plan limits (5-hour, weekly), context fill with alerts, cost, tokens and timer above the prompt, a status line, an Agents panel (/radar), a burn-rate forecast for limits, a session budget (/radar budget) and an account badge.

accounts.title: Account labels
accounts.description: Label your accounts by email domain, one per entry as domain=LABEL (like example.com=WORK). Subdomains match too. Empty: just the email.

showAccount.title: Show account
showAccount.description: Show the signed-in account in the band and the panel.

showSpend.title: Show spend limit
showSpend.description: Read your spend limit in dollars from Anthropic with Claude Code's own login, once a minute, and show it first in the limits. Off: no request is made.

hideEmail.title: Hide email
hideEmail.description: Show only the account's label (or organization), not the email address.

defaultBudget.title: Default session budget (USD)
defaultBudget.description: Cost budget every new session starts with; 0 = none. Change it per session with /radar budget.
